description_en: Sets the execution time settings for an OTA upgrade
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center approve-ota-task --app-instance-group-id 'aig-9ciijz60n4xsv****' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id 'ota-be7jzm29wrrz5****' --ota-type Fota --start-time 2022-08-04T14:36:00+08:00 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ApproveOtaTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the delivery group. You can call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the delivery group belongs. You can call the [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) operation to query the regions supported by Wuying Cloud Application
parameters.help_zh: 交付组所属的地域ID。可以调用[ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~)查询无影云应用支持的地域列表
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the OTA upgrade task. You can call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain the ID.

After you successfully call `ApproveOtaTask`, the `TaskId` changes. Therefore, before you call this operation again, call `ListAppInstanceGroup` to obtain the latest `TaskId`
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级任务ID。可调用[ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~)获取。

OTA升级任务由平台在检测到交付组有新版本时自动生成，不能通过接口主动创建。当`ListAppInstanceGroup`返回的`OtaInfo.NewOtaVersion`为空时，表示当前没有待执行的升级任务，此时没有可用的`TaskId`；也可调用[ListOtaTask](~~ListOtaTask~~)查询该交付组的OTA升级历史记录。
每次调用`ApproveOtaTask`成功后，都会导致`TaskId`变更。因此，再次调用本接口之前，请重新调用`ListAppInstanceGroup`以获取最新的`TaskId`
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the OTA upgrade task
parameters.name: ota_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the OTA upgrade task. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 format
parameters.help_zh: OTA升级任务的开始时间。按照ISO 8601格式填写
parameters.name: start_time

Code.description_en: The execution result. A value of `success` indicates that the call was successful. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Code.description_zh: 执行结果。返回`success`表示成功，否则将返回错误信息

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned when `Code` is `success`
Message.description_zh: 错误信息。当`Code`为`success`时，不返回该参数
Message.example: The task is running and cannot be sumitted.
